purpose: paired detector-level object-scale scene-crop exploration for Ship/Vehicle proposal recall

training.initial_checkpoint: the same mature S1024 fold0 last.pt as P40
training.effective_batch_note: Ultralytics nbs=64: baseline batch8 accumulates about 8 steps; DDP batch60 uses one step, so effective batch remains approximately 64 versus 60

evaluation.primary: delta official quality contribution at the identical fixed threshold
evaluation.confirmation_rule: quality delta > 0.5 points merits fixed Hard then Sentinel confirmation
evaluation.risk_rule: report every coarse recall/FDR change; do not reject only because a rare-class FDR changes by 0.5pp
evaluation.absolute_hard_gate: mean of the three coarse macro FDR values <= 0.20; this is not a per-class FDR ceiling
